identity.title: LER 2023-003-00 for Monticello Nuclear Generating Plant, Condition Prohibited by Technical Specifications due to Inoperable Main Steam Line Low Pressure Isolation Switch

cause.proximate_text: The cause of the failure of the B1 Channel switch was instrument drift. Since no specific failure mechanism was identified, a performance at half of the required SR 3.3.6.1.4 channel calibration procedure period was performed.
cause.theme: instrument drift, no specific failure mechanism identified

nodes.display_name: PS-2-134B, B1 Channel Main Steam Line Low Pressure Isolation Switch
PS-2-134A, A1 Channel Main Steam Line Low Pressure Isolation Switch
B1 Channel switch trip setpoint drifted below TS allowable value
nodes.description: During plant startup on October 7, 2023, the B1 Channel switch reset prior to 686.7 psig, indicating the switch had drifted below the TS minimum allowable value of 815 psig; as-found value on October 10, 2023 was 641.6 psig.

nodes.display_name: Inoperable channel condition not identified upon Mode 1 entry
nodes.description: The plant entered Mode 1 on October 7, 2023 at 0228 without knowledge that the B1 Channel switch was inoperable, so the required TS action to place the channel in trip was not taken.

nodes.display_name: Condition prohibited by Technical Specifications (TS 3.3.6.1) / channel inoperable in Mode 1 without required action
Perform SR 3.3.6.1.4 channel calibration at half the required surveillance frequency
Bring B1 Channel switch within tolerance

chain: instrument drift (cause TBD) -> B1 Channel switch trip setpoint drifted below TS allowable value -> inoperable channel condition not identified upon Mode 1 entry -> condition prohibited by TS (channel inoperable in Mode 1 without required action taken) [mitigated by bringing switch into tolerance; three other MSL Low Pressure channels remained operable]
notes: No specific failure mechanism was identified for the instrument drift; official cause code remains TBD/provisional per Form 366 fields. PS-2-134A is included as a related component referenced in the narrative (calibrated same day, unaffected) but is not part of the causal chain. No SIMILAR_TO edge emitted since the 'Previous Similar Events' section is blank in the narrative. No manufacturer, backup system, or PART_OF relationships were explicitly stated for these switches.
